Check local paw setup

Usage:
  paw doctor [flags]
  paw doctor [command]

Examples:
  paw doctor
  paw doctor --fix --dry-run
  paw doctor --fix --yes
  paw doctor --lint --json
  paw doctor history
  paw doctor explain config.bootstrap
  paw doctor models

Available Commands:
  explain     Explain a doctor finding
  history     Show doctor repair operation history
  models      Check configured model transports

Flags:
      --deep                  run slower probes, including verify dry-run and schema smoke checks
      --dry-run               preview repairs without changing files
      --fix                   apply supported repairs
  -h, --help                  help for doctor
      --json                  write machine-readable JSON report
      --lint                  read-only CI preflight; fail on warnings or errors
      --non-interactive       disable prompts and risky repair actions
      --only stringArray      only run matching check id or section; repeatable
      --severity-min string   minimum severity to report: info, warning, error (default "info")
      --skip stringArray      skip matching check id or section; repeatable
      --yes                   apply repairs without prompting

Global Flags:
      --config string       config file
      --log-format string   log format: text, json (default "text")
      --log-level string    log level: debug, info, warn, error (default "info")
      --no-color            disable colored stderr output
      --trace-file string   trace file
      --verbose             verbose output

Use "paw doctor [command] --help" for more information about a command.
